query:
-- 查询总用户数
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_users FROM users;

-- 查询今天注册的用户
SELECT COUNT(*) as today_registrations 
FROM users 
WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURDATE();

-- 查询最近7天注册的用户
SELECT COUNT(*) as week_registrations 
FROM users 
WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY);

-- 查询所有用户的基本信息
SELECT id, name, email, role, created_at, last_signed_in 
FROM users 
ORDER BY created_at DESC 
LIMIT 20;

-- 查询今天的使用记录
SELECT COUNT(*) as today_usage 
FROM usage_records 
WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURDATE();

-- 查询总使用次数
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_usage FROM usage_records;

-- 查询每个用户的使用次数
SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) as usage_count 
FROM usage_records 
GROUP BY user_id 
ORDER BY usage_count DESC;
